title: NOT a set of 3! Only ONE!
text:
NOT a set of 3! Only ONE!. The description says this comes in a set of 3. But that is somewhat false advertising: the "three" here are the three parts of a single pan combo (the pan itself, a plastic lid and a grill insert), and it is NOT, in fact, a set of 3 pans as we were expecting.
That being said, the pan we did get from this is pretty great. We've used it for a few things so far, including 2 different kinds of deserts and it cleans up nicely and looks like new after each one (no more disposable 9x13 pans for messy dishes!). The grill rack is pretty cool for things like fish or meat, but the cover is just a plastic to preserve it, not oven safe for baking. So if you have a dish that requires being cooked while covered (lasagna for example), you'll need to use some aluminum foil or something similar instead of the included cover.
